rows.desc: The definition API: Architecture, Concept, Part, RuleBook, Options. It depends on no other folder
The base class of each architecture: Define(Root), Configure(Options defaults), Rules(RuleBook)
Concept, Module, External: the kinds of thing that an architecture names (a layer is a concept)
Root, Part, PartGroup, IPartChain, FolderAlias: the folder tree of an architecture, built with Add, AddGroup, And

RuleBook, Rule, Count, Match, Statements: the rules of an architecture. Four verbs: Uses, Denies (references), Has (counts, with AtLeast, AtMost, Exactly, OfOneKind) and Takes (type-argument matches, with InSame)
Options, Access, Boundary, Depth: the defaults of an architecture and of each concept
The resolved architecture and its questions: PartOf, MayUse, and the count and match checks. Plain data in, no ArchUnitNET: each tool asks the same questions here (was Resolution/)

PartOf(type facts): which part a type belongs to (was Match)
MayUse(from, to): allow or deny, and the rule that decides (was Decide)
